slug: 镇守魔门圣女我每天暴涨一年功力
lines: 大周，永安十二年，秋。
岁大饥，人食人。
京城，镇魔司，天牢。
江澜迷迷糊糊地睁开双眼。
一股霉味伴随着一阵腐烂潮湿的味道直冲鼻腔。
“咳咳……卧槽……”
“这他妈给我干哪儿来了？”
他睁开双眼，迷茫地看向四周。
下一瞬，海量记忆，冲入他脑海当中。
江澜，十八岁，大周镇魔司天牢狱卒，江家独苗，父母双亡。
标准的主角配置。
消化完记忆，江澜又转头看了看破破烂烂的班房。
“金手指，我金手指呢哥们？”
这破地方，啥都有，妖魔，武夫，邪魔外道。
对，记忆里好像还有个狗日的针对他来着。
这一副普通人的身体，要是没个金手指，到时候死都不知道怎么死的。
而且能进天牢的，好像都是危险家伙来着。
江澜念头还未落下，班房外，便传来一阵喝骂。
“江澜呢？狗日的又在哪儿偷懒儿呢？”
“哐当！”
一声巨响，房门被一脚踹开。
一个满脸横肉的壮汉，凶神恶煞走进班房内，身后还跟着三四个满脸幸灾乐祸的狱卒。
江澜瞥了几人一眼。
哪儿有好人呐？
领头这个操蛋的叫王虎，算是这天牢里的小校尉，也是他的顶头上司。
别看狱卒这活儿不咋地，但是令牌却是世袭制的。
也就是说，爹死了儿子上。
一旦哪个令牌没主了，死的还是个孤家寡人，那令牌就能交给比较亲近的人。
狱卒这活儿，在如今的老百姓眼里，也算是个肥差，能吃饱饭，动不动还能整点儿肉吃，是正儿八经的铁饭碗。
所以，外头有不少人是花大价钱买的。
自打江澜他爹死了，王虎就一直变着法儿的折腾他，就等着他什么时候咽气儿了，好把令牌给弄到手呢。
“狗日的，跟你说话，咋的，聋了？”
“龙？龙可是帝王之证……”
江澜下意识接梗。
“说他娘什么呢？没死就滚起来干活儿。”王虎满脸颐指气使道，“今儿开始，你去甲字牢房值夜。”
王虎身后，几个狱卒面色齐齐一变。
content_en:
Dazhou, the twelfth year of Yong'an, autumn.
There is great hunger and people cannibalize people.
The capital city, the Demon Suppression Division, and the Tianlao.
Jiang Lan opened his eyes drowsily.
A musty smell accompanied by a rotten and damp smell hit the nose.
"Ahem...fuck..."
"Where the hell did this come from?"
He opened his eyes and looked around confusedly.
The next moment, a massive amount of memories rushed into his mind.
Jiang Lan, eighteen years old, is the jailer of Mo Si Tian Prison in Dazhou Town. The only child in the Jiang family, both parents are dead.
Standard protagonist configuration.
After digesting the memory, Jiang Lan turned around and looked at the dilapidated class room.
"Goldfinger, where is my goldfinger, buddy?"
This wretched place has everything, demons, warriors, evil spirits and heretics.
Yes, there seems to be a bitch targeting him in my memory.
With this body of an ordinary person, if he didn't have a golden finger, he wouldn't know how he would die.
And those who can enter the sky prison seem to be dangerous guys.
Before Jiang Lan could finish his thoughts, there was a burst of yelling and swearing outside the class room.
"Where's Jiang Lan? Where are you lazying like this?"
"Clang!"
There was a loud noise and the door was kicked open.
A strong man with a sinister face and a fierce look walked into the prison cell, followed by three or four jailers with faces full of gloating.
Jiang Lan glanced at a few people.
Where are the good people?
The fucking leader is called Wang Hu. He is the junior captain in the prison and his immediate boss.
Although the job of a jailer is not good, the token is hereditary.
In other words, if the father dies, the son will die.
Once a token loses its owner and the person dies alone, the token can be given to someone closer to him.
In the eyes of today's common people, the job of a jailer can be regarded as a fat job. He can have a full meal and eat some meat at every turn. It is a serious iron rice bowl.
Therefore, there are many people out there who spend a lot of money to buy them.
Ever since Jiang Lan's father died, Wang Hu had been torturing him in various ways, waiting for him to die so he could get the token.
"What the hell, why are you deaf when I talk to you?"
"Dragon? The dragon is the symbol of the emperor..."
Jiang Lan subconsciously picked up the joke.
"What the hell are you talking about? Get up and work if you're not dead." Wang Hu said with an arrogant look on his face, "Starting from today, you will be on duty in cell A."
Behind Wang Hu, the expressions of several jailers changed.
